tracker_rules.authorized_reporters: the task owner or project manager

scheduling_rules.selection: earliest slot inside the request window where every required attendee is both available and conflict-free
scheduling_rules.recurring_requests: one start time must work on every recurrence date
scheduling_rules.optional_attendees: include only when requested, non-sensitive, and free at the chosen slot; never include optional attendees in sensitive meetings
scheduling_rules.deduplication: do not create a request that already has a calendar event with the same linked_request_id

communication_rules.critical_blocker_escalation: overdue Critical tasks still Blocked after reconciliation
communication_rules.blocker_recipients: project manager and the task escalation contact
communication_rules.document_announcement: upload and announce the newest approved team-visible version when that exact version has not been announced
